texts.facts: The respondents have filed an application for vacating the e stay mainly on the ground that the petitioner is having remedy of ad appeal under Section 46(4) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, Pr hence, stay be vacated and petition be dismissed. Shri Bagadiya has produced copy of the order dated 01.02.2016 a hy passed by the coordinate bench of this Court in W.P.No.2665/2013, by which the similar application for vacating of stay on the ground that of ad availability of alternate efficacious remedy has been rejected. of "I.A.No.309/16, an application for dismissal of the petition filed by the rt State primarily raises three grounds. The first being that the petitioner can ou approach the Food Safely Appellate Tribunal under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short the Act, 2006) against the order of C Adjudicating Officer under Section 68 of the Act.

In the instant case, the petitioner's product, i.e. cream biscuits have been found to be misbranded. Even otherwise, this petition is pending since 2014 and interim order is still in operation.
